snapshots.reason: Initial Commit with core architecture: 8 editing methods (ROME, MEMIT, MEND, IKE, FT, KN, SERAC, EFK), editor framework, dataset loaders, and evaluation pipeline established
Mature feature expansion: 14 editing methods (added GRACE, DINM, MALMEN, MELO, PMET, LoRA, FT-API), model parallelism support, multi-model support (LLaMA, GPT-J, T5, ChatGLM, Mistral, Qwen)
Current HEAD with comprehensive feature set: 28+ editing methods (added WISE, AlphaEdit, EMMET, R-ROME, UNKE, DeepEdit, etc.), steering module, multimodal support, latest transformer compatibility

analysis_summary: EasyEdit is a knowledge editing framework that evolved from 179 files (2023-07-04) to 834 files (2025-12-03) over 1579 commits spanning 2.5 years. No version tags exist. The early snapshot captures the foundational architecture with 8 core editing methods. The mid snapshot (commit 800/1579) represents significant growth with 14 methods and broad model support. The current snapshot includes 28+ methods, steering capabilities, and multimodal features, representing a 4.7x file growth from early to current.
